edits.ko: 슈퍼 마리오 메이커 투의 트랙 편집을 보세요. 각진 경로를 구부리고, 구간들을 이어 둥근 고리를 만듭니다. 이렇게 곡선의 모양을 쉽게 조절하려면 어떤 숫자를 사용하면 좋을까요? 이번에는 곡선 밖의 제어점으로 형태를 잡는 베지에 곡선을 만들고, 같은 경로를 원하는 구간으로 나눠 보겠습니다.
edits.en: Watch track editing in Super Mario Maker 2. Angular sections become rounded corners and join into a loop. What numbers would make a curved shape easy to control? We will build our own Bezier curve using control points outside the path, then split the same curve into the portions we need.
edits.reason: Actual path editing opens thesis; do not identify Nintendo's internal curve representation. Outside control-point role remains taught immediately in002 and iterative blending in003.
edits.screen: Maker2 local202–247 native editing. Track active corner→rounded joins→closed loop, speech overlaps. Transition to our four-control-point model; game does not display our Bezier handles.

edits.ko: 마리오 갤럭시에서 스타를 타고 출발할 때를 떠올려 보세요. 도착할 곳뿐 아니라 어떤 방향으로 나아가기 시작하는지도 경로의 모양에 영향을 줍니다. 우리가 만든 베지에 곡선에서는 그 방향을 손잡이로 정할 수 있어요.
edits.en: Recall Mario launching toward another planet in Super Mario Galaxy. A path is shaped not only by its destination, but also by the direction in which it begins. In our Bezier construction, the handles let us specify that direction.
edits.reason: Real departure and curved flight motivate endpoint tangent; do not attribute Bezier implementation to Mario.
edits.screen: NativeGalaxy90–104 action, then our fixed curve b0..b3 and derivative arrows; retain all endpoint differentiation.

edits.ko: 새티스팩토리에서는 선로를 한 구간씩 미리 보고 이어 놓습니다. 우리도 긴 곡선 가운데 필요한 부분을 따로 다루고 싶다면, 먼저 그 부분을 독립적인 곡선으로 표현할 수 있어야 하죠.
edits.en: In Satisfactory, rail sections are previewed and connected one at a time. If we want to work on just part of our long curve, we first need to represent that portion as a curve in its own right.
edits.reason: Observed segment construction motivates subdivision goal; no claim commercial game performs exact deCasteljau subdivision.
edits.screen: NativeSatisfactory258–285 preview/build sequence, short outline of completed segment. Move to our original unchanged Bezier, isolate interval and compute new control points while explaining.
